Quick answers

The things people ask us most.

All questions
What is CuratedbyPriti?

CuratedbyPriti is a handmade and hand-picked gift shop in Wagle Estate, Thane West, Maharashtra. We make soft pipe cleaner bouquets that last for years, framed florals, mirror-work and Lippan wall decor, pearl canvases, illustration portraits and custom gift hampers.

Do you deliver, and to which areas?

Yes. We have delivered in Thane, Bhiwandi, Airoli and many more areas. Message us your area on WhatsApp and we will confirm delivery and timing.

Can gifts be personalised?

Yes. Almost everything can be personalised: photo cards on bouquets, custom bike art panels, portraits drawn from your photo and names added to pieces. Send your photos and ideas on WhatsApp.

What is your returns policy?

Made-to-order and personalised pieces cannot be returned once work has begun. If your gift arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, message us within 24 hours of delivery with photos and we will repair, replace or refund. Unused ready-stock pieces can be exchanged within 3 days. The full policy is on the Returns and terms page.

Ready to give something thoughtful?

Tell us who it is for. We will help you find the right gift.

Our story

A gift should feel chosen for one person

CuratedbyPriti is a gift shop in Wagle Estate, Thane, built around handmade and hand-picked pieces. Soft pipe cleaner bouquets that last for years, framed florals, mirror-work wall panels, pearl canvases and portraits drawn from your own photos.

We believe the best gifts say something about the person receiving them, so almost everything here can be personalised. Add photo cards to a bouquet, build a panel around a loved one's bike, or turn a favourite picture into an illustration.

Visit the shop, message us on WhatsApp, or send a photo and an idea. We will help you find the right thing.

Questions and answers

Questions, answered

Everything about ordering, delivery, personalised gifts and returns.

About the shop

What is CuratedbyPriti?

CuratedbyPriti is a handmade and hand-picked gift shop in Wagle Estate, Thane West, Maharashtra. We make soft pipe cleaner bouquets that last for years, framed florals, mirror-work and Lippan wall decor, pearl canvases, illustration portraits and custom gift hampers.

Where is the shop located?

CuratedbyPriti is at Wagle Industrial Estate, Thane West, Thane, Maharashtra 400604 (plus code 5WXX+7J Thane). Walk-ins are welcome, and you can also pick up orders placed on WhatsApp.

What are the opening hours?

The shop is open Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 8 pm, and closed on Sunday. Hours can change on festival days, so message us on WhatsApp to confirm before you travel.

Ordering and delivery

How do I order a gift?

Open the Order page, tap your choices and your message is written for you. It opens in WhatsApp, where you can add photos and details. You can also message +91 90299 79652 directly or walk in to the shop.

Do you deliver, and to which areas?

Yes. We have delivered in Thane, Bhiwandi, Airoli and many more areas. Message us your area on WhatsApp and we will confirm delivery and timing.

Can I collect my order from the shop?

Yes. You can pick up from our Thane West shop. Choose "Collect from the shop" when you build your order.

Gifts and personalisation

Can gifts be personalised?

Yes. Almost everything can be personalised: photo cards on bouquets, custom bike art panels, portraits drawn from your photo and names added to pieces. Send your photos and ideas on WhatsApp.

Do handmade pipe cleaner bouquets wilt?

No. Our bouquets are made from soft pipe cleaners, so they do not wilt and are made to last for years.

Do you make gift hampers?

Yes, all kinds. Tell us who it is for and what they love, and we put together a hamper for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, festivals or no reason at all. Ideas for what goes inside include a handmade bouquet, a framed photo, a candle, a mug, a journal, dried flowers, sweet treats and wall decor.

How much do your gifts cost?

Pieces in the collection range from ₹300 to ₹2,199. 11 pieces are on offer right now, with savings up to 36%. The price is shown on every product.

Returns, offers and contact

What is your returns policy?

Made-to-order and personalised pieces cannot be returned once work has begun. If your gift arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, message us within 24 hours of delivery with photos and we will repair, replace or refund. Unused ready-stock pieces can be exchanged within 3 days. The full policy is on the Returns and terms page.

Are there any offers or free gifts?

Yes. Offer prices apply on 11 pieces, loyal customers get a free small gift, and one lucky Instagram follower wins a customised frame free every month.

How can I contact CuratedbyPriti?

Message or call +91 90299 79652 on WhatsApp, send a message on Instagram @curatedbypriti, or email prajapatianu1@gmail.com.

Still have a question?

Message us and we will reply as soon as we can.

Policies

Returns and terms

How returns, orders and delivery work, so there are no surprises.

Returns and refunds

Made-to-order and personalised pieces

Portraits, custom frames, photo cards and anything made from your photo or your choices are made just for you, so they cannot be returned or exchanged once work has begun.

Damaged or wrong item

If your gift arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, message us on WhatsApp within 24 hours of delivery with clear photos, and a short unboxing video if you have one. We will repair, replace or refund, whichever is fair.

Ready-stock pieces

Unused ready-stock pieces in their original packing can be exchanged within 3 days of delivery or pickup. Please message us first so we can confirm.

Not covered

Small differences in colour or size between the photo and the piece, because every handmade item is slightly unique. Damage caused after delivery. Dried flowers and fabric items that have been washed or handled roughly.

How refunds are paid

Approved refunds are returned to the way you paid, within 5 to 7 working days.

Terms and conditions

Placing an order

Orders are placed on WhatsApp or in the shop. An order is confirmed once we have agreed the price, payment and delivery or pickup details with you in chat.

Prices and offers

All prices are in Indian rupees and can change without notice. Offer prices apply to the pieces they are shown on and cannot be combined with other offers.

Custom orders

For personalised pieces we will share the design or a preview for your approval before we begin. Please check names, dates and spellings carefully, because we cannot change them after approval. Photos you send must be yours to use.

Cancellations

You can cancel or change an order before we start making it. Once work has begun on a made-to-order piece, it cannot be cancelled.

Delivery

We deliver in Thane and nearby areas, and we confirm your area, charges and timing on WhatsApp. Delivery times are estimates and can change on festival days. Please share a correct address and a phone number that is reachable on the day.

Product photos

Colours can look different on different screens. Handmade pieces may vary slightly from the photos.

Privacy

We use your name, number and address only to complete your order and will not share them with anyone else.

Questions

Message us on WhatsApp or write to prajapatianu1@gmail.com and we will help.
